summary.headline: Solar Eclipses and Planetary Conjunctions
summary.text: Chapter VII explains solar eclipses as omens of major accidents, including the destruction of kings and wealthy people, drought, famine, rain, and illness according to the eclipse’s sign and planetary aspects. Chapter VIII introduces planetary conjunctions and their effects, distinguishing fortunate and evil planets.
